title: fix(plugin-audit): the activity list opens newest first, without platform rows, under a plain name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8wqkG9Mqwy9zSp7FB9yFG9)_

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

Fixes #30036

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：首页「查看全部动态」打开的列表默认按时间从新到旧，只列人对业务记录做的改动；元数据、迁移、用户与成员（含登录戳）、签名密钥这些平台行移到同页「全部条目」视图；标题改为「动态」，描述改成白话。
- 为什么改：经理点进去想看「今天发生了什么」，看到的是乱序的原始表，夹着平台内部行，标题还和 CRM 自己的「活动」撞名。
- 风险与回滚：只改 sys_activity 的声明（两个列表视图、标签、描述）和译文，不删数据、不改写入；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-activity.object.ts（默认视图的过滤条件与排除名单）、sys-activity-default-view.integration.test.ts。
- 两分钟验证：pnpm dev:crm 登录后新建一个客户，点首页「查看全部动态」，应只见刚才的客户行且最新在上；切到「全部条目」能看到登录戳、签名密钥与迁移行。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## Proposed title wording (acceptance 4)

The object label becomes **Activity Feed** (zh-CN **动态**, ja-JP アクティビティフィード, es-ES Feed de actividad), with the default view titled **Recent activity** (zh-CN **最近动态**) and the second view **All entries** (zh-CN **全部条目**). In the CRM this reads 「动态 / 最近动态」 beside the app's own 「活动」 sidebar entry, and matches the Home link's own word 「查看全部动态」. One overlap to weigh: the Studio capability toggle `enable.feeds` is also rendered 动态 in zh-CN; it labels a switch on the object form, not a page, so I kept 动态 here. If you prefer to keep them apart, 动态流 is the alternative.

## What changes

`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-activity.object.ts` (the platform half the triage routed here) declares two list views on `sys_activity`, plus a new label and description:

- **`recent`, declared first.** Both doors (Home's 查看全部动态, `HomePage.tsx`, and the bell's Activity tab, `InboxPopover.tsx`) open `/apps/APP/sys_activity` with no view named, and the Console then opens the first declared view (`ObjectView.tsx`: requested view, then the reader's pinned view, then an `isDefault` view, then `views[0]`). So the doors needed no change and no `ui/**` file is touched. The view sorts `timestamp` descending and filters:
  - `actor_id` is not null: a person acted. A system write leaves the actor null (ADR-0118 D1): the migration ledger, platform settings written at boot, seeds.
  - `object_name` not in: the metadata store (`sys_metadata`, `sys_metadata_history`, `sys_metadata_commit`, `sys_metadata_audit`), the data-migration ledger (`sys_migration`, `sys_migration_journal`), and every object the identity domain declares, derived from the exports of `@objectstack/platform-objects/identity` (`sys_user`, `sys_member`, `sys_organization`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_session`, `sys_jwks`, teams, business units, OAuth and SCIM objects, …). The metadata-store names are spelled out, because `check:platform-object-tenancy-census` loads every object file from source and cannot evaluate `@objectstack/metadata-core`'s root entry (its only export of those definitions); the new test holds them equal to the definitions' own names, so a rename reds there.
- **`all`**: every row the reader may read, newest first, no filter.
- **Label** `Activity Feed`, **description** "What people did to records recently, newest first: who created, changed or deleted what. Entries are kept for 14 days." (the 14 days is the object's own `lifecycle.retention.maxAge`).
- Translations in the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES bundles (hand-written leaves; `check-i18n-bundles --write` regenerated `en` and dropped the source-hash entries for the re-translated leaves).

Why the identity domain is excluded by object rather than by actor (measured on fresh `pnpm dev:crm` boots, see Verification): the sign-in stamp (`Updated User "Dev Admin": Last Login At and Last Login IP`), the first signing-key mint (`Created 签名密钥 (JWKS)`) and an administrator adding a person (`Created User "Mia Member"`, `Created Member "ID (member)"`) are all written **under a person's own id**, not as the system, and the added person can read the last two. The only column that tells a sign-in stamp from a profile edit is `changed_fields`, and `parent-field-query-guard.ts` refuses a filter on that column for any reader withheld a field anywhere, so a default view naming it would 403 for members. Consequence: an administrator's edits to users, members and organizations are in `all`, not `recent`.

Rows stay where they are (acceptance 2, second sentence): nothing is deleted and nothing changes in what is written. An administrator reaches every excluded row in two places: the `all` view on the same page, and the compliance ledger `sys_audit_log` (Setup's audit log), which holds its own row for each CRUD-mirrored write (measured: `sys_migration create`, `sys_user update`, `sys_platform_setting create`, `sys_platform_setting_audit create` are all on the ledger).

## Acceptance

> 1. The page opened from these doors shows newest first by default.

`recent` is first and sorts `timestamp` desc. Browser: three accounts created about a second apart list as 远航贸易, 星河科技, 华东物流有限公司 (newest first). Test: `` `recent` serves only what people did to records, newest first ``.

> 2. Rows about platform internals (metadata history and drafts, migrations, a user's login stamps) are not in that default page. The rows stay available to an administrator on the audit surface.

Browser as admin: `recent` lists 3 rows; `all` lists 8, including the sign-in stamp, the JWKS mint, the migration and the two platform-setting rows. Drafts are `sys_metadata` rows and fall under the same exclusion. Audit surface: see above.

> 3. The description a reader sees says what the page is, in plain words.

Browser header: 「最近大家对记录做了什么，按时间从新到旧：谁新建、修改或删除了什么。条目保留 14 天。」

> 4. The page's title does not collide with an app's own 活动. The wording is the implementer's to propose on the PR.

Proposed above. Browser header: 「动态 / 最近动态」, with the CRM's own 「活动」 entry visible in the sidebar beside it.

> 5. A browser check as an admin and as a member.

Admin: as above. Member, after merging `origin/main` with #30108's PR #30222 (`member_default` now reads `sys_activity`): a user the admin created and gave the CRM's `sales_rep` position. Home shows the activity card and its 查看全部动态 link; the link opens `recent`: 3 rows, 创建了 客户 "远航贸易" / "星河科技" / "华东物流有限公司", newest first. `?view=all` shows 5: the same three plus 创建了 成员 "ID (member)" and 创建了 用户 "Mia Member", the platform rows `recent` leaves out. The plain API read of the object (no view) returns the same 5 in no time order, which is the defect the default view closes.

## Tests

- New `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/sys-activity-default-view.integration.test.ts` (9 cases): the declaration (first view is `recent`, both views sort `timestamp` desc, the excluded list equals the definitions' names, the identity objects measured writing under a person's id are in it, `all` carries no filter, the old description and label are gone), and on a real engine + `driver-sqlite-wasm` + `AuditPlugin`: the real CRUD mirror leaves `actor_id` null for a system write and the person for a person's; `recent`'s own rules, lowered the way the Console lowers a view filter and parsed by the server's `parseFilterAST`, serve exactly the person's business rows newest first; `all` still lists the excluded kinds (sign-in stamp, metadata, signing key, member added, migration).
- Ablation, one rule at a time with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` (run at `61bb8996`; neither rule line has changed since): removing the `actor_id` rule → 1 failed / 7 passed; removing the `object_name` rule → 1 failed / 7 passed; both restores verified `blob == HEAD`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` at `2110d932` (after merging `origin/main`): Test Files 71 passed (71), Tests 1137 passed (1137); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck` → exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `recent` is the same cut as Home's activity card only as far as a query column can say it. Home narrows to the objects the reader's apps list (a client-side roster); a server-declared view cannot know that, so a person's edit of another platform object (a permission set, a setting) still appears in `recent`. The excluded list covers every platform row the card named plus the two measured on a fresh boot.
- System-written rows on business objects (a seed, an automation run as the system) are out of `recent` by the actor rule, as they are out of Home's card ("real human actions only").
- Screenshots: I have no image-hosting path through the relay, so the six screenshots (admin Home, admin `recent`, admin `all`, member Home, member `recent`, member `all`) are held with the seat; the readings above are the page text captured from the same runs.

## Verification

<details><summary>Browser, admin (fresh pnpm dev:crm --fresh, Console via Vite, zh-CN)</summary>

Home → 查看全部动态 → `/apps/com.example.crm/sys_activity`. Header 「动态 / 最近动态 · 3 · 只读 · 审计日志」. Rows: 创建了 客户 "远航贸易" / "星河科技" / "华东物流有限公司", each by Dev Admin.

`?view=all`: header 「动态 / 全部条目 · 8」. Rows add: 创建了 签名密钥 (JWKS) (Dev Admin), 更新了 用户 "Dev Admin"：最近登录时间和最近登录 IP (Dev Admin), 创建了 数据迁移 "pinyin-search-companion" (—), 创建了 Platform Setting Audit Entry (—), 创建了 Platform Setting "api_key_policy_started_at" (—).
</details>

<details><summary>Browser, member (sales_rep position, after #30222)</summary>

Home: 1 「查看全部动态」 link → `/apps/com.example.crm/sys_activity`. Header 「动态 / 最近动态 · 3」. Rows: 创建了 客户 "远航贸易" / "星河科技" / "华东物流有限公司", each by Dev Admin, newest first.

`?view=all`: header 「动态 / 全部条目 · 5」; adds 创建了 成员 "ID (member)" and 创建了 用户 "Mia Member" (both by Dev Admin).

Before #30222 (head `4cd5356dc`): `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity` → `PERMISSION_DENIED`; no Home link; direct URL 「无权访问」.
</details>
